name: Riso Duotone Poster
desc: A fluorescent two-ink risograph poster: a halftone sun over ridged hills, the pink and blue plates jittering in and out of registration on the beat while overprint blooms dark where they cross.

hue.doc: ink hue offset applied to both plates

style.doc: aesthetic: two-ink fluorescent halftone / single-ink newsprint / white schematic line-art on cyanotype (abstract) / smooth duotone gradient, no dots

pal.doc: ink duo: fluoro pink+blue / green+orange / purple+red / teal+navy

act.doc: multi-minute sun program: rise slowly climbs, set sinks, hold steady
